name: Ragi Banana Ladoo
ingredients: 1–2 tbsp warm unsweetened soy milk, to bind
steps: Dry-roast the ragi flour in a pan on low heat for 6 minutes until fragrant. Add the besan and roast for 3 minutes. Cool slightly.
Heat the oil gently and mix into the flours with the cardamom and salt.
Add the mashed banana and enough soy milk to make a dough that holds when pressed.
Chill for 15 minutes and store in the fridge for up to 3 days.
note: A nut-free, sugar-free, date-free ladoo; the banana is the only sweetener. Eat 1–2 as a snack.
